jobs.description: About Flexport:  At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year.  The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us. Build and grow with us! Join Flexport Germany as an Account Executive and supercharge your career! The opportunity: The Enterprise Account Executive (ENT) is responsible for driving complex, high-value enterprise deals and establishing long-term strategic partnerships with large customers. This role owns advanced, multi-stakeholder sales cycles that often span regions, business units, and decision layers. The ENT AE operates with a high degree of autonomy, shaping deal strategy, influencing executive stakeholders, and orchestrating cross-functional teams to deliver differentiated, value-driven solutions. Your responsibilities as an Account Executive, ENT include, but are not limited to the following: Pipeline & Opportunity Ownership Own and close high-value, complex enterprise opportunities, consistently meeting or exceeding individual quotas. Build a strategic pipeline through self-prospecting, account planning, and SDR partnership. Proactively identify whitespace, expansion potential, and multi-entity opportunities within target accounts. Maintain forecasting, opportunity hygiene, and deal governance in Salesforce (SFDC). jobs.title: Full-Stack Engineer - ElevenAPI
jobs.description: About ElevenLabs ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. How we work High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. What we offer Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. jobs.title: Technical Product Manager (d/f/m) - People Intelligence Apps
jobs.description: Our story: Every year millions of people are either filing their taxes in fear or giving up on their tax refund altogether. We're working on fixing that. Our intuitive app enables anyone, regardless of education or background, to file their taxes with newfound confidence. Spread across Germany, Spain and the UK, the team at Taxfix Group with its brands Taxfix and Steuerbot, is a compassionate group of solution-finders. We speak our minds openly, and with over 400 professionals, including tax experts, developers, and IT security experts, we're rich in ideas and voices. The group has facilitated more than 3.5 billion euros in tax refunds for its customers since its founding in 2016. The opportunity: As our People Intelligence/Apps Technical Product Manager within the People Strategy & Insights team, you'll be a critical part of developing our agentic enablement platform and responsible for building and shipping the People applications that power how we hire, develop, and grow our team — from workforce planning tools to AI-augmented performance and org design solutions. Reporting to our Director of People Strategy & Insights and collaborating closely with People Partners, Leaders, FP&A, IT, and AI and Platform Engineering, you'll translate complex People domain challenges into elegant, scalable products that make a real difference in how we operate. At Taxfix, we're building an AI-native company — and this role sits right at the heart of that mission. Your responsibilities Develop a deep understanding of the employee as “Builder” concept, and map the requirements different parts of the organisation have to unlock the capability of Engineers and non-Engineers to ship agentic workflows. Design and implement AI-augmented tools and human-AI collaboration patterns, experimenting with emerging techniques to push the boundaries of what's possible in People operations. The handoffs between product, design, and engineering are slowing us down. The companies moving fastest are doing it with people who own the full loop, from the user problem to the shipped feature, without losing the thread. At Taxfix, we’re rebuilding our R&D organization around this idea. We call these people builders . A Builder has a primary craft, one they’re genuinely excellent at, but they don’t stop there. They stretch across product, design, and engineering as the situation demands, using AI to cover the gaps. They’re accountable to outcomes, not job descriptions. Taxfix has put €5 billion back into our customers’ pockets and we aren’t stopping there. We operate in Germany, Spain, and the UK, and we’re in the middle of a genuine AI transformation in how we build and how we’re organized. Assume there’s no designer to give you a Figma file. No engineer to hand the spec to. The magic is knowing what to build, why, and in what order, then making it happen. That’s why we come into the office every day: to connect, learn from one another, and grow together. Genau dafür suchen wir dich. Deine Aufgaben Du kümmerst dich ausschließlich um unzufriedene Kundinnen und Kunden. Das ist deine einzige Aufgabe. Du rufst Kunden mit einer Beschwerde schnell zurück, hörst zu und verstehst, was wirklich passiert ist. Du bringst Ruhe in angespannte Gespräche und findest gemeinsam mit dem Kunden eine faire Lösung. Du klärst offene Fragen intern mit unserem Team, zum Beispiel zu Abo, Kündigung, Rückerstattung oder Inkasso-Schreiben, und meldest dich verlässlich beim Kunden zurück. Du dokumentierst jeden Fall sauber in unserem Ticketsystem (Zendesk) und antwortest auch per E-Mail. Dein Ziel: Aus einem verärgerten Kunden wird ein zufriedener Kunde. Das bringst du mit Viel Einfühlungsvermögen und Geduld. Du bleibst ruhig, auch wenn es am Telefon mal laut wird. Gutes Deutsch für Telefongespräche. Ein Akzent ist überhaupt kein Problem, perfektes Deutsch brauchst du nicht. Du bist zuverlässig, denkst mit und hältst, was du versprichst. Idealerweise Erfahrung im Kundenservice, Beschwerdemanagement oder Callcenter. Quereinsteiger mit dem richtigen Gespür sind ebenfalls willkommen. Ein ruhiger Arbeitsplatz, stabiles Internet, PC oder Laptop und ein Headset. Wichtig – Arbeitsmittel: Ein Windows-Laptop oder Windows-PC sowie ein Headset werden nicht vom Arbeitgeber gestellt. jobs.title: Engineering Lead
jobs.description: You'll ship agents that move money, and you'll keep the rhythm that gets them shipped. Accounts payable, accounts receivable, treasury: autonomous agents that read the invoice, match it, negotiate the discount, release the payment, and reconcile the cash. Every one of those actions runs in production with a customer's CFO watching the result. Most of what the industry calls engineering culture was written for a world where humans typed every line. That world ended. We want to build the 2026 version: engineers who work with agents as a matter of course, where the unit of work is the loop (spec, generate, evaluate, correct, ship) rather than the ticket, where code review means reviewing the evals and prompts as hard as the diff, and where a regression suite over real customer invoices is what lets us move fast on systems that touch money. Nobody has a settled playbook for this. You'll help write ours, from inside a pod. This is a player-coach role. You'll spend most of your week shipping code in one of our pods, and you'll manage the engineers day to day: 1:1s, feedback, growth, the hard conversation when it's needed. The rest goes to the delivery rhythm: pods commit to milestones in Linear, post progress daily, and review misses every Friday with the Head of Product and the CTO. You run that review and the follow-ups. The management share grows as we go from 8 engineers to 16 and beyond; this role is the natural path to Head of Engineering. You'll report to the CTO. Causa Prima is built by the team behind Taulia and backed by Creandum. What you'll do Ship as a senior engineer, 70 to 80% of your week. Take the hardest work in your pod, unblock the integration nobody wants, and review the code that touches money personally. You set the bar by clearing it in front of the team. Manage the engineers day to day. Weekly 1:1s, direct feedback, growth plans, and the honest conversation about who's ready for more scope and who's in the wrong seat. The CTO owns hiring decisions

jobs.description: Staff Engineer You'll be the most senior engineer on the agents that run finance operations for our customers — designing, building, and operating the autonomous agents that handle accounts payable and receivable end-to-end. From invoice validation and dispute resolution to cross-company negotiation and cash optimization. This is an individual-contributor role at the top of our ladder: no direct reports, full technical authority over the architecture the rest of the team builds on. What you'll do Agent architecture — Design the multi-agent system: agent boundaries, event contracts, orchestration patterns, and the separation between LLM reasoning and deterministic enforcement. LLMs inform; rules enforce. You own where that line sits for every action that moves money, and the authorization gateway that makes it non-negotiable. Matching and reconciliation — Three-way matching across purchase order, goods receipt, and invoice with configurable tolerances; cash application against bank statements and remittance advices, including partial payments and residuals; the exception paths that follow when any of it fails. Unglamorous but important: The foundation everything agentic sits on. Validation & anomaly detection — Business rule checks, duplicate and near-duplicate detection, pricing discrepancy detection, and anomaly detection across time. Precisio

jobs.description: Our mission: eliminating every barrier to mental health. Spring Health is a global mental health company on a mission to eliminate every barrier to mental health. This role oversees the full customer lifecycle, aligning Spring’s solutions with customer goals to drive engagement and revenue. jobs.description: At Moss, we give finance professionals the power to automate their day-to-day and make forward-thinking decisions. Our culture is what makes that possible: we play to win, we obsess over quality, and we win as One Moss, and it works. Moss closed a €35 million Series C in August 2026, crossing a €1 billion valuation, and became one of Europe's fintech unicorns. Join us for what's next. We are now looking for a Partnerships Associate to support our growth journey in Germany. This is a junior-level role designed for early-career professionals with a strong interest in finance, accounting, or Fintech. You’ll help identify and connect with potential partners, build a strong pipeline, and support the foundation for lasting cosmmercial relationships. Over time, you’ll have the opportunity to develop into a full-cycle Partner Manager role, taking end-to-end ownership of strategic partnerships. Your responsibilities Here's a bit more on what you can expect to be doing day-to-day: Partner Identification & Assessment: Research and identify prospective partners aligned with Moss’ strategic priorities and ideal customer profiles. Support the initial assessment of partners through qualitative and quantitative analysis (e.g., partner fit, customer base, integration potential). Outreach & Pipeline Building: Own the top of the funnel for our partnerships pipeline. Proactively reach out to prospective partners via email, LinkedIn, events, and other channels. Engage partners with a clear value proposition and qualify initial interest. First 6 months: ~80% outbound/cold calling to build your own pipeline; shifts toward strategic partner management as you progress. Relationship Building & Support: Assist in building and maintaining strong working relationships with partners. Participate in partner calls and meetings, prepare follow-ups, and support ongoing communication. Help deliver value to partners by understanding their needs and coordinating with internal teams. Process & Reporting

jobs.title: Android Software Engineer
jobs.description: About ActAI There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting. Our first application is an agent-first mobile communication app. We believe building applications that users use daily for communication, coordination and collaboration needs will help integrate AI into their lives. The net effect is to eliminate misinformation, achieve low coordination costs, enable high quality tasks and collaboration at scale with minimal or little prompting. Role As an Android Software Engineer, you own the Android client experience, how AI feels, behaves, and performs on mobile devices. This is not a thin client role. You will build a production Android application where AI interactions are core to the product, and performance, reliability, and clarity matter. Focus Build and maintain production Android apps using Kotlin. Integrate AI-powered features (chat, vision, voice, recommendations) via backend APIs. Design UX patterns for AI interactions, including streaming responses, retries, and partial results. Optimize performance, memory usage, and responsiveness for AI-heavy flows. Implement analytics, logging, and feedback capture to support AI evaluation and iteration. Collaborate closely with backend and ML engineers on API contracts and system behavior. Ensure app stability, security, and scalability in production environments. Ideal Experiences 3+ years of Android development experience using Kotlin. Hands-on experience integrating AI features (e.g. LLM, vision, speech APIs). Strong understanding of asynchronous programming (Coroutines, Flow). Familiarity with REST or gRPC APIs and structured data formats. Strong debugging and performance profiling skills. Comfort building in environments

jobs.title: Mechanical Design Engineering Team Lead
jobs.description: About pplwise pplwise is a recruiting consultancy for fast-growing technology companies across Europe. Through Recruiting as a Service and Executive Search, we fill key roles for our clients, from start-ups to publicly listed companies. We are filling this position for our client Filics. About our client: Filics Filics is reinventing intralogistics with autonomous mobile robots (AMRs) that change how material moves. Its double-runner system makes Filics the first and only AMR that can drive through load carriers such as Euro pallets. This breaks with forklift logic and sets a new standard for efficiency. Filics is a small, hands-on team that solves hard problems with engineering excellence. Leadership goes to those who take initiative and consistently deliver. As Senior Mechanical Design Engineer (m/f/d) at Filics, you will lead the mechanical design of the robots as they move from prototype to series production. About the role This is an on-site/hybrid role in Munich, close to engineering and assembly. Filics builds its own robot hardware in-house: mechanics, electronics and software. Orders are growing, and the robots are moving from prototypes to series production. Designs that worked in the lab now need to be built reliably, at scale and at the right cost. The hardest problems often sit between disciplines: parts that work on their own can fail once they're assembled with the electronics. The mechanical team has four engineers, most of them at the start of their careers, and they need someone who guides them every day. You'll be the technical lead for the mechanical side of the product and the counterpart to the electronics lead, so the current mechanical manager can focus on core R&D. Your time splits roughly evenly between hands-on engineering and technical leadership. You'll work closely with Electronics, Production, Procurement and the CTO, and you'll set the engineering habits while the team is still small. What you'll do Mentor the mechanical engineers day

jobs.title: Account Executive
jobs.description: Can you help us fix the world's most broken supply chain? The fashion industry produces over 100 billion garments a year. 60% end up in landfill, not because people don't want these clothes, but because the supply chain for getting secondhand fashion from donation to resale is completely offline, manual, and broken. Fleek is fixing this. Our mission is to make secondhand the first choice. We're building the infrastructure powering the global secondhand clothing trade, through a B2B marketplace and the AI systems digitising the supply chain behind it. Through Fleek, vintage stores, online resellers, and retail buyers source graded secondhand inventory directly from wholesalers and rag houses across multiple countries. Our key enabler is FleekSort, an AI model fine-tuned on secondhand fashion, that can grade, price, and categorise items with just a photo, turning what has historically been an opaque and manual trade into a structured, searchable, and tradable global inventory layer. Since 2022, we've saved 9 million items from landfill while tripling in size year-on-year. We're backed by some of the world's best investors, including a16z, Y Combinator, and HV Capital, alongside world-class angels who helped build Depop, Shopify, and Postmates. Today, we serve thousands of resellers and retailers across the UK, Europe, and the US. With the secondhand fashion market projected to reach $350B by 2027, Fleek is building the AI-native operational and financial backbone for secondhand commerce globally. We're looking for people who want to build something that matters, and move fast doing it. Sound good? Keep reading. jobs.title: Quadrants: Compiler Lead
jobs.description: What Quadrants is Quadrants is an open-source translation layer that turns ordinary Python into optimized machine code at runtime, across CPU (Arm64, x86) and GPU (AMDGPU, CUDA, Metal, Vulkan) backends. CUDA is the primary target, with x86 the strong runner-up, especially for real-time simulation. The others drive adoption and support fast prototyping for research. The ambition is explicit: build the best “Python compiler” in the world for physics and performance-critical numerical computing. We are fully committed to it, and we intend to beat leading alternatives like Nvidia Warp, Numba, or Triton. It’s a standalone project with its own roadmap, built in the open. Genesis, our physics simulator, is its first and top-priority user, the source of its hardest workloads and its benchmarks. But Quadrants is general-purpose infrastructure for anyone writing performance-critical numerical Python, not an internal tool that happens to be public. The bet: high-performance code should feel natural to write. Engineers write plain Python in a NumPy or PyTorch style, and Quadrants makes it fast. The role You own Quadrants end to end: the API, the IR and lowering, the optimization passes, the numerical primitives, and the roadmap. Our ultimate objective: engineers write for readability and maintainability, never for performance. They write the version of an algorithm they are most comfortable with, and Quadrants rebuilds it into kernels that run as if an expert had hand-tuned them. Performance is the compiler’s job, not theirs. Getting there is a frontier problem, part research and part engineering, and we intend to define the state of the art on it, relentlessly pushing the limit further. It calls for two things at once: the low-level GPU and compiler skill to make a single kernel optimal, and the ability to keep the whole system coherent as it grows. jobs.title: Genesis-World: Core Physics Engineer
jobs.description: What we're building Robots will learn in simulation before they hit the factory. Genesis-World is our bet on that future. Genesis-World is an open-source, general-purpose simulation platform for physical AI from Genesis AI . One unified multi-physics engine: rigid bodies, FEM, MPM, particles, cloth, fluids. A robot arm can pour water onto sand, grasp a deformable object, or cut a soft body, all in the same simulation. Nyx, our in-house renderer, may be the most promising renderer for robotics out there: real-time photo-realistic rendering, advanced features like depth of field, and state-of-the-art techniques never seen before. Sensors of every kind: cameras, lidar, IMU, contact forces, temperature, plus arguably the most advanced tactile simulation available ( paper ). And the engine keeps growing: we are developing internally the most comprehensive and fastest Incremental Potential Contact ( paper ) solver for deformable body dynamics we know of, soon to be open-sourced. It powers real business applications, from full-fledged box packaging with labelling machine and all, to wire harnessing and lab automation, without any physics hack or compromise. Everything is Python-first and runs anywhere. Kernels are written once, and Quadrants, our in-house JIT compiler, lowers them to CUDA, AMD ROCm, Apple Metal, Vulkan, x86, and ARM64. A single laptop or a datacenter. Massively batched GPU simulation for learning at scale, and complex non-batched scenes where CPU wins outright. This is at the core of Genesis AI's strategy . jobs.title: GPU Engineer
jobs.description: About Kog At Kog, we're building real-time LLM inference for AI agents. Coding agents execute sequences of tasks where each step depends on the model's previous response. The faster the model generates tokens, the faster these agents can reason, code, and act. Our approach is to co-design model architecture, the inference engine, and low-level GPU kernels to minimize generation latency on standard NVIDIA and AMD datacenter GPUs. We've developed several technologies to make this possible: Monokernel: a persistent GPU program that keeps the entire token generation loop on the GPU, avoiding CPU handoffs. KCCL: our custom inter-GPU communication layer, designed to minimize latency. Delayed Tensor Parallelism (DTP): a model architecture that overlaps communication with computation and weight loading. Laneformer 2B: our code-generation model demonstrating this co-design approach. Our engineers work directly with GPU hardware, using CUDA, PTX, HIP, and CDNA ISA to optimize execution. Implementing and optimizing a new AI model for a specific GPU architecture can take months of manual engineering. Meanwhile, new models are constantly being released. Our goal is to use AI agents to implement and optimize the models we choose on the GPUs we choose, in a fraction of the time required today. These agents will build on the GPU optimizations and hardware insights our team has developed. They'll explore optimization strategies, generate and modify kernels, verify correctness, benchmark performance on real hardware, and iterate based on the results. We want to make model porting and GPU optimization much faster and repeatable, allowing Kog to keep pace with the latest AI models rather than spending months adapting each one manually. This is a major engineering direction we're now developing, and you'll help shape it. Learn more at https://blog.kog.ai . Votre rôle ne s’arrête pas à la validation du schéma cible : vous accompagnez les équipes de delivery jusqu’à la mise en production. jobs.title: Sales Development Representative (all genders) - Switzerland

Mit mehr als 4.500 bewirtschafteten Parkflächen in Europa sind wir bereits international aktiv und seit 2022 auch in der Schweiz. Als Sales Development Representative (all genders) treibst du massgeblich das Wachstum in einem unserer dynamischsten und wichtigsten Märkte voran. Du identifizierst strategische Zielaccounts in der Schweiz, öffnest Türen zu Top-Entscheidungsträgern bei Asset Managern, Retailern sowie Immobilienbewirtschaftern und schaffst so das Fundament für hochvolumige Deals unserer Account Executives. Dafür suchen wir ambitionierte Outbound-Profis mit ausgeprägter Leidenschaft für die Neukundenakquise , die eigenverantwortlich wertvolle Marktpotenziale erschliessen. What to expect Outbound-Akquise: Du gewinnst neue Kunden ausschliesslich über aktive Ansprache per Telefon, E-Mail und LinkedIn und vereinbarst qualifizierte Termine für unsere Account Executives. Account-based Prospecting: Du definierst Zielaccounts mit vielen Standorten, baust dir einen Überblick über Entscheidungswege und sprichst mehrere Entscheidungsträger pro Account gezielt an. Zielgruppen: Du arbeitest mit Eigentümern und Verwaltungen von Immobilien, Retailern sowie Gemeinden in der Deutschschweiz. Qualifizierung: Du klärst Bedarf, Entscheidungsprozess und Potenzial und übergibst sauber vorbereitete Opportunities an das Account Executive-Team. jobs.title: Software Engineer, Knowledge Engine  – Data Infrastructure
jobs.description: The Knowledge Platform team builds Exa's knowledge engine. We continuously synthesize information from across the web and beyond into one of the world's largest open-domain knowledge graphs, with hundreds of billions of evidence-backed claims. The work has two halves: construction pipelines that decide what to trust, and retrieval engines that decide how best to search it. Our goal is to give agents answers to any factual question about the world with unprecedented precision and completeness. In this role, you'll build the knowledge construction pipelines : turning everything from a 100k docs/s web crawl to vendor datasets into a graph of what is true about the world, and keeping it correct as data changes. This is greenfield work with a massive scope. There is no off-the-shelf system for building a model of the world from the open web, so you'll make foundational decisions, from how claims are represented and resolved to how trust is assigned and how the graph evolves over time, that everything built on top of it depends on. What you'll do Continuously synthesize the live web crawl, vendor deliveries and APIs, and other off-the-web sources into one typed graph: extraction that turns pages and records into ontology-shaped claims, each carrying its provenance, timestamp and confidence. Bring every new source in cleanly: versioned, append-only history with schema evolution, late-arriving and corrected records, and replayable cursors, so every claim traces back to the exact delivery that produced it. Decide what to trust: entity resolution across billions of records (blocking, pairwise scoring, clustering) into canonical people, companies, places and publications, then truth discovery that weighs source reliability, recency and corroboration to reconcile conflicting claims. Keep that picture current and convergent: streams arrive continuously, out of order and at very different rates, so the graph is eventually consistent by design. You'll build incremental computation

jobs.title: Head of AI
jobs.description: About Poesis Whoever builds the leading intelligence for finance will create far more than returns. Poesis is the AI-native investment firm running autonomous agents that predict markets, construct portfolios, and manage risk. Our founders managed institutional capital at Capital Group ($3T AUM) and led enterprise ML at Goldman Sachs and Amazon. We're building a new type of firm, where live capital is the training ground for an intelligence that compounds with every signal. About the Role Financial markets offer something rare in AI research: a continuous, objective feedback loop where you can test new ideas, measure whether they actually work, and use real-world outcomes to inform what you build next. It’s an opportunity to do frontier research with a direct line between the ideas you explore and their real-world performance. As Head of AI, you’ll lead Poesis’s AI strategy and research, setting the technical direction for how we apply frontier AI to investing. jobs.title: Deployed Engineering Manager, Northern Europe & DACH
jobs.description: About Us At LangChain, our mission is to make intelligent agents ubiquitous. We build the foundation for agent engineering in the real world, helping developers move from prototypes to production-ready AI agents that teams can rely on. We began as widely adopted open-source tools and have grown to also offer a platform for building, evaluating, deploying, and operating agents at scale. With $125M raised at Series B from IVP, Sequoia, Benchmark, CapitalG, and Sapphire Ventures, we’re at a stage where we’re continuing to develop new products, growth is accelerating, and all team members have meaningful impact on what we build and how we work together. LangChain is a place where your contributions can shape how this technology shows up in the real world. Today, our platform includes LangSmith (Observability, Evaluation, Deployment, Fleet, and Sandboxes), our open source frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, and Deep Agents), and the newly launched LangSmith Engine for autonomous agent improvement. We have 100M+ monthly open source downloads, 6,000+ active LangSmith customers, and 5 of the Fortune 10 use LangSmith in production (+ 35% of the Fortune 500 overall), including teams at Klarna, Clay, Coinbase, Workday, Lyft, Cloudflare, Harvey, Rippling, Vanta, LinkedIn, Monday.com, Nvidia, and Bridgewater. About The Role As the Deployed Engineering Manager for Northern Europe, you will lead a team of deployed engineers from our hub in Amsterdam, working with our customers across DACH and Benelux. You'll help build and shape the team, grow the people in it and make sure our customers get the technical partnership they need to build and run great agents in production. This is an opportunity to have outsized impact at a company shaping the future of AI-powered software. DEs work alongside our sales team to help our prospects and customers build reliable, scalable agents for their business using our suite of products: LangChain, LangGraph, Deep Agents and LangSmith. Je bent een inhoudelijke vraagbaak voor collega’s en steekt zelf graag de handen uit de mouwen. Met een proactieve blik kijk je verder dan de dagelijkse praktijk en zie je kansen om processen te verbeteren. Plan and run tests on laboratory and production-representative equipment. Analyze sensor and actuator data, use system identification to develop or calibrate dynamic models, and compare predictions with measured responses. jobs.title: Senior AI/ML Engineer
jobs.description: We are looking for an experienced AI/ML Engineer to develop and deploy machine learning solutions for real-world underwater acoustic sensing systems. Optics11 is a deep-tech company developing cutting-edge fiber-optic sensing technologies for challenging environments, including underwater acoustics, offshore energy, and defense applications. Our systems enable high-performance sensing and monitoring through advanced photonics, signal processing, and data-driven intelligence. We are expanding our R&D team with a Senior AI/ML Engineer who combines strong mathematical foundations with applied machine learning expertise to enhance the next generation of intelligent acoustic sensing solutions. Role Overview: As a Senior AI/ML Engineer, you will apply machine learning to real-world underwater acoustic sensing challenges using Optics11’s fiber-optic technology platforms. You will work closely with acoustics engineers, signal-processing specialists, and embedded/software teams to develop robust ML components that integrate seamlessly into operational systems. This role requires a strong foundation in signal processing, applied mathematics, and statistics, and the ability to combine physics-based acoustic algorithms with data-driven ML methods. Responsibilities: Develop and implement machine learning solutions for underwater acoustic sensing use cases, including detection, classification, localization and anomaly monitoring within fiber-optic sensing systems. Select and adapt modelling approaches based on data availability, operational constraints and system requirements. Apply strong foundations in applied mathematics, statistics and signal processing (e.g., beamforming, spectral analysis, detection pipelines) and integrate these with modern data-driven ML techniques. Design, train, evaluate and benchmark AI/ML models, ensuring robustness, generalization and deployment readiness. jobs.title: Senior Customer Solutions Engineer
jobs.description: Life at Plume At Plume, we believe that technology isn't about moving faster, it's about making life's moments better. Which is why we've built the world's first, and only, open and hardware-independent service delivery platform for smart homes, small businesses, enterprises, and beyond. Our SaaS platform uses WiFi, advanced AI, and machine learning to create the future of connected spaces—and human experiences—at massive scale. We now deliver services to over 60 million locations globally and have managed over 3 billion devices on our platform. We're expanding rapidly, pioneering a new category, and we achieved our Series F funding in just four years. Our customers include many of the world's largest Internet Service Providers (ISPs) who look to Plume to help them evolve their smart home offerings while gleaning insights from their own data. With a bias for action and a love for being trailblazers, the team at Plume embodies a combination of relentless curiosity and imaginative innovation. We challenge ourselves to think in ways that other companies don't, work to do what should be done (rather than what can), and if we can't do it exceptionally well, we don't do it. It's how we've assembled a team of world-class builders, thinkers, and doers. And it's how we're reinventing what's possible every day. Plume is seeking an experienced and highly motivated Senior Customer Solutions Engineer to join our dynamic team. As a key technical advisor, you'll work directly with Internet Service Providers (ISPs), acting as the bridge between their business needs and our cutting-edge solutions. You'll play a crucial role in the sales process, from initial discovery to successful deployment, ensuring our partners achieve maximum value from our products. This is a fantastic opportunity for a technically adept individual with a passion for networking, cloud, and AI who thrives in a customer-facing role. jobs.title: Junior Quantum Design Engineer
jobs.description: About Us QuantWare is building the world’s most powerful quantum processors to solve humanity's greatest challenges. We do this with our unique VIO™ technology, the only QPU architecture that breaks the hardware barriers that have held quantum computing back, unlocking the path to MegaQubit quantum processors. With VIO, we are paving the way for the hyper-scale quantum computers that will change the world. And delivering on that vision demands people who don’t shy away from tackling the hardest challenges of our time. That’s where you come in! As a Junior Quantum Design Engineer , you will take on a vital, hands-on responsibility in creating our next-generation quantum processors. Your core focus will be centred on the layout, simulation, and verification of quantum processor components and superconducting circuits. Collaborating directly with other design engineers alongside cross-functional R&D teams spanning fabrication, measurement, and system integration, you will transform conceptual device architectures into production-ready designs while closing the feedback loop between theoretical design intent and empirical performance. Your work will be essential as we scale to increasingly complex systems and deliver on the promise of quantum computing. What you'll be doing Design and lay out superconducting circuit components and test structures, such as resonators, qubits, and control lines. Perform electromagnetic and circuit simulations to predict device parameters and optimise designs. Contribute to design verification, including design-rule checks and review of layouts against fabrication process constraints. Compare simulation results with measurement data to validate design models and feed learnings back into future design iterations. Help develop and maintain design tooling, automated layout scripts, and documentation to make our design flow faster and more robust. jobs.title: AI Builder
jobs.description: The short version Plenty of companies are still running AI pilots. We moved past that a while ago: AI agents and human experts create, localise, check and refresh content for global B2B brands every day, across markets and languages. The next question is a harder one: not how to make content, but which content a client should make at all. That's where you come in. As an AI Builder, you work on both sides of that. About half your time goes to bringing new clients live. The rest goes to building the intelligence that tells each client what to make next: where competitors outrank them, which pages are losing ground and need a refresh, which topics are an opening nobody has claimed yet, and whether they show up when people ask ChatGPT or Google instead of searching. We've built our own CRM; our teams work with agents that do everything from setting up a tailor-made demo for a prospect to preparing sales calls and routing client feedback to the right person, and people across the company build their own tools. If you want to do serious work with AI, this is a good place for it. Everyone here is already building. What Contentoo does Most content tools make the client the editor. Most agencies make them the project manager. We'd rather make them the approver: they brief, review, and approve, and we run everything in between, inside their own workflow and tools. That makes us a product with a large service layer, sitting where SaaS, service and AI overlap. None of that works without good foundations, so that's where we start. Before any agent runs, we capture what makes a client's content theirs: strategy, tone, terminology, compliance rules and hero pieces, per language and market, confirmed by the client. Every agent, expert and signal draws on that brand context. Skip it, and you get generic content, faster. There's no shortage of software that tells a client what to write. jobs.title: Product Manager MISSION AIRCRAFT (m/f/d)
jobs.description: About the role: As Product Manager Mission Aircraft, you will own the product strategy, roadmap and lifecycle of our military multi-mission aircraft. The aircraft is designed as an optionally piloted platform combining manned and unmanned operations with modular mission capabilities for applications such as Counter-UxS, ISR, maritime and border patrol, training and manned-unmanned teaming. You will work at the intersection of customer needs, operational requirements, engineering feasibility and commercial viability. In close collaboration with Engineering, Operations, Sales, Product Marketing and other stakeholders, you will translate complex mission needs into clear product priorities and an executable roadmap. This end-to-end ownership, from customer discovery and product strategy through delivery and lifecycle development, is consistent with Quantum Systems' current Product Management model What is your Day to Day Mission: Own the product strategy and roadmap for the Mission Aircraft, translating market, customer and operational requirements into clear product priorities and measurable outcomes. Drive customer and market discovery by engaging with end users, governmental customers, Sales and Solutions teams to understand operational challenges, mission scenarios and capability gaps. Shape the multi-mission capability roadmap across relevant applications such as Counter-UxS, ISR, maritime and border patrol, training and manned-unmanned teaming. jobs.title: Technical Support Engineer
jobs.description: Join GLS/NXT as a Technical Support Engineer and help keep the future of out-of-home delivery running smoothly. We’re building the OOH Platform - a smart parcel locker platform that connects carriers, locker providers, and end customers across Europe. As a Technical Support Engineer, you make sure every incident is thoroughly investigated and resolved. You handle incoming tickets, analyze logs and data to find the source of a failure, and follow each case through until it’s fully fixed. When an error keeps coming back, you push until its root cause is found and eliminated - and you build the processes, metrics, and reporting that make support predictable and transparent. If you enjoy digging into complex problems, take ownership until things are truly fixed, and thrive in a collaborative and fast-moving environment, we’d love to have you on board. Let’s build the future of logistics - together. Tasks Own incoming support tickets from triage to resolution, prioritizing by business impact. Analyze logs (e.g. Datadog) and production data (SQL) to find where an issue originates. Escalate confirmed bugs to the right team with clear, reproducible reports. Act as a technical point of contact for external partners on incidents and integration issues, requesting missing details and following up until each issue is properly resolved. Identify recurring cases and drive them to a root-cause fix instead of closing each ticket as a one-off. Build deep knowledge of the parcel lifecycle (drop-off, collection, returns, labelless flows, state transitions) and of how carrier and provider integrations behave, including edge cases. Build and improve support processes, including triage rules, escalation paths, and follow-up routines. Define and track support metrics such as ticket volume, resolution time, recurring issues, and response quality, and prepare regular reports on open issues and trends to push for long-term fixes. Requirements 3+ years of experience in technical support , app

Your work will focus on transforming complex, high-volume telemetry—spanning logs, metrics, and events across HPC, networking, and platform layers—into actionable insight that drives operational excellence and proactive reliability. A core part of your responsibility will be developing intelligent observability and automation systems, including advanced alerting strategies, anomaly detection, and AI-driven tooling that reduces L1/L2 escalations and removes operational toil. You will also contribute to Continual Service Improvement (CSI) initiatives by building frameworks for reliability measurement, automated remediation, and system health evaluation. In addition, you will play a central role in turning SRE reliability initiatives into scalable engineering solutions. This includes designing and delivering capabilities such as inventory management systems, performance testing frameworks, and automated performance result collection. You will also help eliminate manual workflows involved in onboarding new regions, facilities, and clusters, embedding automation and standardisation into every stage of infrastructure

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager
jobs.description: About Kernel Agents are starting to sell, buy and operate on behalf of companies. But before an agent can close a deal, qualify an account, route a lead or assess risk, it has to answer a basic question: which company is this? Today, that answer is messy, and no one answers it reliably. Business identity lives across CRMs, ERPs and third-party datasets full of duplicates, missing parent companies, stale addresses and incorrect enrichment. The cost shows up across the enterprise: sales teams miss revenue opportunities because they lack the right account context; operations teams take on avoidable exposure because risk signals are fragmented or wrong; and finance teams end up chasing, writing off, or defaulting on bad debt that should have been caught earlier. Humans have worked around that mess for years. Agents cannot. They need a reliable business identity layer they can trust. Kernel is building that layer: the business registry for agents. We issue a permanent Kernel ID for every business, plus the context an agent needs to act on it. We have strong product-market fit: Ops, data, and revenue teams at Gong, Legora, Mistral, Canva, and Checkout already use Kernel across their enterprise systems. Agents are next, and there will be far more of them. We have raised $20M from top VCs and operators, and we are growing 12x YoY . The role You will own one of Kernel’s product areas end-to-end, working directly with the founders and the engineering team Own all stages from discovery to implementation for our core product areas and bets Data- and metrics-driven (without being obstinate about it) Tolerate (maybe even relish) ambiguity, and know when to make decisions quickly vs. when something needs more thought Bridge the link between our customers and our engineering team Help shape the product roadmap and vision for Kernel What we’re looking for We are looking for a full-stack product thinker who can own and lead product work from discovery to implementation. jobs.title: Lab Technician
jobs.description: About Fractile Fractile was founded in 2022 on the bet that, eventually, the world’s most capable AI systems would be limited in their impact by the time taken to produce useful outputs. We bet everything on the logical conclusion: that the only way to truly unlock this latent value, to make speed viable at scale, was to radically re-invent the hardware that we run our frontier AI models on. Ever since, we have been building chips and systems that tackle this problem: how to efficiently generate output at thousands of tokens per second, while handling the complexity and capacity challenges of operating large models at very long contexts. The workloads that push to the limits of the current frontier are already transformational; it is the technical and economic limits on inference speed that are constraining progress. The defining work of the 21st century will be marked by the engine of inference delivering immense and diffuse chains of intellectual inquiry, in drug discovery, in software engineering, in materials discovery, in any field where progress is driven by deep reasoning and intelligence to resolve complex problems. We’re looking for a detail-oriented Lab Technician to keep our Bristol labs running safely and reliably. You’ll support hardware engineers with testing, setup and equipment upkeep in a fast-paced AI hardware company. jobs.title: Lead Product Manager - Patient Data Collection (x/f/m)
jobs.description: Set a new pulse for healthcare! We are looking for a Lead Product Manager to join the Patient Profile team in the Patient domain. Your mission will be to make the patient health record complete, accurate and current enough that everything else we build can act on it, the health recommendations, care plans and assistant experiences that help people take their health into their own hands. You will work in a feature team developing the Patient Health Record, health trackers, patient account and online identity, contributing directly to the quality of the medical support we provide to both patients and practitioners. A patient record is built from four channels: what patients enter themselves, what they share when preparing a consultation, what we retrieve from health professionals' systems, and what they connect from third-party sources such as Apple Health, Google Health Connect and national health record services. Three of those channels belong to teams you will not manage. You will own the outcome across all four, the most leveraged place to sit in a health platform, and only reachable through other people. You will also work inside a hard regulatory perimeter: health data, GDPR, consent by design. jobs.title: Platform Security Engineer (x/f/m)
jobs.description: Set a new pulse for healthcare! We are looking for a Platform Security Engineer to join the Security team at Doctolib. Your mission will be to protect sensitive healthcare data while enabling rapid, secure innovation. You will be responsible for securing Doctolib's cloud infrastructure and application ecosystem, combining multi-cloud security expertise with hands-on platform engineering — contributing directly to the safety of millions of patients and care teams who rely on our platform every day. Working in the tech team at Doctolib means building innovative products and features to improve the daily lives of care teams and patients. What you'll do Your responsibilities include but are not limited to: Own a platform security workstream end to end, from architecture to enforcement: scope it with your tech lead, design the control, roll it out progressively (report-only, then enforce), handle exceptions, and see it through to full coverage. Typical examples: hardening IAM across our AWS accounts, tightening cluster admission policies, or closing a class of misconfiguration for good. Ship every change as code: Terraform and GitHub pull requests, peer-reviewed and always reversible. No console clicking, no undocumented state. Harden our cloud and infrastructure baseline and keep it hardened: IAM permissions and access reviews, secrets management, network and cluster guardrails, CI/CD and supply chain controls — building the guardrails and driving remediation of what they surface with platform and engineering teams, turning recurring findings into automation rather than tickets. Investigate and improve: lead incident investigations on the platform perimeter end to end, and continuously improve detection rules and response playbooks in our Elastic SIEM. Work in the open: write clear technical notes, drive adoption of your changes with the engineering teams they affect, and grow through code review and pairing with the rest of the team.
